Road to 1.0
Pre-release roadmap

A world built milestone by milestone.

Each milestone adds a complete part of Ichor Online. Plans can change after player testing. We have not announced a date for version 1.0.

01
First milestone

Foundation

Build the first complete adventure loop. Create a character, prepare in town, explore, fight enemies, gain power, and return stronger.

Under considerationPvP · Ironman or hardcore mode · Housing · Pets · Advanced guild features
Milestones show priorities, not release dates. We can move features when testing shows a better path.
